purricane.name: Purricane
purricane.$comment: High-key emissive, not light mode. A lit aquarium, not a white webpage. Text is dark on light here; everything else still glows.

type.$comment: Set larger than Iosevka would sit. Small x-height relative to cap height; looks cramped at 11px.

visualizer.$comment: Rotation is a constant. Audio drives the pattern, never the speed.

accessibility.$comment: Clamp beat blooms below 3Hz regardless of BPM. Fast tracks skip blooms rather than stacking them.

cone.name: Cone
cone.$comment: Cached NEXRAD reflectivity backdrop. Inherits Eyewall's palette. Cached data must always display its age.
